data.one_liner: Compile-time safe and easy to manage service locators for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Toor provides compile-time safe service location for Dart and Flutter. It supports factories, lazy singletons, mutable lazy singletons, async factories, and factories with parameters without requiring code generation.
use_when: You want compile-time safe dependency injection without setting up code generation.
You need support for parameterized factories, async factories, and lazy singletons.
You want to easily override or reset dependencies during testing.
avoid_when: You prefer annotation-driven dependency injection frameworks like get_it with injectable.
You require complex hierarchical module dependency graphs.
strengths: Supports multiple instances of Toor for isolated domains or testing.
weaknesses: Lacks advanced dependency graph validation tools found in codegen-based DI.
